The list of network security policies. A PUT introducing a ContentInspection policy is incompatible if any associated fabric has no configured inspection connection, regardless of whether selectors currently match traffic. The request is rejected before persisting or distributing the proposed changes, preserving the previously accepted policies; mixed compatible and incompatible associations cannot partially apply changes or silently skip inspection. An unattached group, or one attached only to compatible fabrics, may contain ContentInspection policies. Removing ContentInspection policies remains allowed, subject to other validation.

A JSONPath into the request's params.arguments object, which is `$`: 1 to 8 segments, the first `.name` and the others `.name` or `[*]` (at most once), for example `$.repoName` or `$.paths[*]`. With a path, a missing key (also in an array element), a key that differs only in case, or a value of the wrong type on the way is a mismatch: an Allow condition holds only when there is none and every selected value passes, and a Deny condition also holds when there is one, when the path selects nothing, or when a selected value is not a string or boolean. Without a path every string or boolean argument value and every object key is compared; this is allowed only for ExactMatch or Contains in a Deny rule and for NotExactMatch or NotContains in an Allow rule.
The values to compare with: 1 to 64, or 1 to 16 non-empty values for Contains and NotContains.

The name of the rule: 1 to 63 ASCII letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-', starting with a letter or digit, and unique within the policy ignoring case. Flow logs report the rule that decided as `mcp-<n>/<name>`.

The priority of the rule, unique within the policy. Rules are tried from the lowest value and the first rule that matches decides; a policy has 1 to 5 rules. When none matches, defaultAction applies to every MCP request except session requests (initialize, ping, notifications, the list methods, JSON-RPC responses, and requests with no body such as GET and DELETE), which pass.
